prompt: Add a bounded retrying background delivery job to an existing Axum service.
expected_actions: scan job lifecycle, shutdown, persistence, and existing dependencies before design
define retry, backoff, deduplication, cancellation, overload, and recovery
create a complete trace packet with AC/SC/VO mappings
request approval before any new dependency
run Rust static, unit, integration, restart, and drain evidence as applicable
forbidden_actions: invent Kafka or NATS JetStream as a global default
claim restart safety without a durable-boundary test
